query: I’m evaluating a 49-year-old man with AMI. In male inpatients aged 44–54 with AMI, what is the 75th percentile of the first 72‑hour lab instability score? Also compare critical lab frequency to general inpatients and report cohort LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY male_inpatients_with_ami_los.los) AS percentile_75, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN male_inpatients_with_ami_los.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN male_inpatients_with_ami_los.subject_id END) AS critical_labs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN male_inpatients_with_ami_los.deathtime IS NULL THEN male_inpatients_with_ami_los.subject_id END) AS total_labs, SUM(male_inpatients_with_ami_los.los) AS total_los, SUM(CASE WHEN male_inpatients_with_ami_los.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortality_count FROM male_inpatients_with_ami_los;
